input: full eight-layer router dump; adjacent four source shards folded into each of two ranks
context: inference cold copy and immutable-weight same-trace warm reuse
measurements: GPU event and host time; each raw sample maximum over two ranks; ten paired rotated samples per layer
scope: native/optimized planner plus real expert copies and dispatch/combine; no expert GEMM, backward, gradients or optimizer
gate: Require directly measured positive segment benefit against fastest comparable native baseline; do not promise arbitrary-input or training benefit
preserve: all attempts, failures, raw samples, source and input hashes
